name: Both-states detector control: the probe must FIRE on the known-broken state
description: Blueprint 45 of 96 (BP-DBG-02). FLAGSHIP. Before a probe's SILENCE may be cited as evidence that something is fixed or absent, the probe is run against a deliberately KNOWN-BROKEN fixture and required to fire there. A probe that is silent in both states measures nothing, and a measured case exists where exactly such a probe was one step from being reported as verification. The distinctive mechanism is the fixture PAIR and the asymmetry of the two gates: failing to fire on broken is FATAL, while an unconstructible broken fixture yields the honest verdict UNVALIDATABLE which every dependent claim then inherits. Fully deterministic - no model judgement enters the verdict.

probe.description: The detector, hook, guard, gate, monitor or suite under test - identified by its invocation, not by its name

broken_fixture.description: The known-broken state. If it cannot be constructed the verdict is UNVALIDATABLE - the workflow does not proceed to a VALID verdict without it.

healthy_fixture.description: The known-healthy state the probe must be SILENT on

subject_is_test_suite.description: When true, the broken state is produced by REVERTING a real historical bug and the suite must go red (mutation testing applied to the suite)

expected_fire_signal.description: What counts as FIRING. Declared up front so 'it fired' cannot be re-defined after the run.

fixture-builder.description: Constructs the broken and healthy fixtures, or declares the broken one unconstructible. Never edits the probe.

probe-runner.description: Runs the probe unmodified against one fixture and records the raw result. Interprets nothing.

stages.title: S0 CONSTRUCT a genuinely broken fixture and its healthy twin

work_unit.title: Construct a broken/healthy fixture pair for one probe, or declare the broken state unconstructible
work_unit.question_or_target: Build the smallest state in which the subject is GENUINELY broken in the way the probe claims to detect, plus a healthy twin differing only in that respect, and prove the difference independently of the probe under test. If no broken state can be constructed, emit UNVALIDATABLE rather than a fixture that is only cosmetically broken.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a cosmetically-broken fixture produces a false VALID verdict; this step carries the judgement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: an INDEPENDENT demonstration that the broken fixture is broken - a second observation that does not use the probe under test - plus the diff between the two fixtures showing they differ only in the property at issue
tests_required: the two fixtures must differ, and the diff must be confined to the property under test
the broken fixture's brokenness must be demonstrated WITHOUT the probe - using the probe to prove its own fixture is circular
with subject_is_test_suite=true the broken state must be produced by reverting a REAL historical bug, not by editing a test
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: an independent reviewer who inspects both fixtures and confirms the broken one is broken by their own observation
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:TST-0328 emitted only when fixture-pair.json exists, parses, names both fixtures, and carries the independent brokenness demonstration; FAILED:TST-0328 unconstructible-broken-state when no genuine broken state exists
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after two cosmetic fixtures, enumerate at least two alternative ways to break the subject genuinely before a third attempt

stages.title: No broken fixture means UNVALIDATABLE - an honest verdict, not a pass
S1 RUN the probe against the broken fixture - it MUST fire
A probe that does not fire on the broken state measures nothing - this is FATAL
S2 RUN the SAME probe bytes against the healthy fixture - it MUST be silent
A probe that fires on the healthy state is a false-positive generator
Both runs must have used the SAME probe bytes, or the two results are not comparable
S0b OPTIONAL - for a test SUITE: revert each real historical bug in turn and require red
S3 VERDICT - VALID, MEASURES-NOTHING, or UNVALIDATABLE

impact.blast_radius: fixtures under command-center/detector-control/**; the probe itself is never edited - Edit is denied and a byte-equality gate enforces it

worked_example.scenario: A guard that imports its dependency inside try/except ImportError and reports 'no findings' when the import fails.
worked_example.healthy_fixture: the dependency present; the guard finds a planted violation and exits non-zero
worked_example.broken_fixture: the dependency RENAMED so the import fails; the guard silently reports no findings and exits 0
worked_example.outcome: probe_fired_on_broken == false -> fires-on-broken FAILS with the fatal verdict MEASURES-NOTHING. The guard was silently DISARMED and every 'no findings' it ever printed is void
worked_example.measured_precedent: a codex-exec probe printed no parse error in the broken state as well as the fixed one and was one step from being reported as verification; and 1 of 6 real-bug mutations survived a green suite, exposing a genuine hole
worked_example.unvalidatable_case: for a monitor whose broken state depends on an external outage nobody can stage, S0 emits UNVALIDATABLE; the monitor is then labelled so, and every claim that cites its silence inherits the tag
worked_example.suite_variant: with subject_is_test_suite=true the broken state is produced by reverting a real historical bug: the suite MUST go red. A suite that stays green is not protecting that behaviour, whatever its coverage number says

x_extensions.distinctive_mechanism: a fixture PAIR with asymmetric gates - not firing on broken is fatal, an unconstructible broken state is UNVALIDATABLE - plus a byte-equality check that both runs used the same probe, and independent proof of brokenness so the probe cannot certify its own fixture
contraindications: NOT when a known-broken state cannot be constructed - then the probe is unvalidatable and must be labelled so, not blessed
NOT a substitute for the fix itself - this validates the instrument, nothing more
NOT for third-party probes you cannot run against your own fixtures
x_extensions.not_a_duplicate_because: diff-scoped mutation testing mutates PRODUCTION code to test a suite; this mutates SYSTEM STATE to test a detector, and therefore applies to hooks, monitors and gates that have no test suite at all.
